sourceVersion: Seminole County Public Schools 2027-2028 Student Attendance Calendar, Board Approved 5/13/2025
seoTitle: Seminole County School Calendar 2027-2028 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Seminole County Public Schools calendar 2027-2028 with first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, PDF and ICS.
calendarNotes: Seminole County Public Schools starts the 2027-2028 school year on August 10, 2027 and lists May 24, 2028 as the end of the fourth quarter and last student day. Thanksgiving Break runs November 22-26, Winter Break runs December 20-31, and Spring Break runs March 13-17. Teacher workdays and student holidays on October 11, January 3, January 4, and March 20 are important planning dates because they sit near quarter transitions or major breaks. The official PDF lists inclement-weather make-up days in this order: January 4, January 3, October 11, March 20, and May 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Seminole County start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Seminole County Public Schools starts the 2027-2028 school year on Tuesday, August 10, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Seminole County Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 13 through Friday, March 17, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Seminole County in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The SCPS 2027-2028 student attendance calendar lists Wednesday, May 24, 2028 as the end of Quarter 4 and the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SCPS 2027-2028 dates are listed as make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists make-up days in this order: January 4, 2028; January 3, 2028; October 11, 2027; March 20, 2028; and May 25, 2028.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2026-2027 SCPS Calendar
content: The first student day remains August 10 for both 2026-2027 and 2027-2028.
The last student day moves from May 25 in 2027 to May 24 in 2028.
Spring Break moves from March 15-19 in 2027 to March 13-17 in 2028.
Winter Break shifts from December 21-January 3 to December 20-31, with January 3 and January 4 listed as student holidays after the break window.
